Name: Nyapu Style Bear Family
Author: VCrows
Description:
[size=5][b]Nyapu Style Portraits for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16197]Bear Family[/url][/b][/size][size=4][b]
[b][size=4]This mod now supports the full outfits for the Bear Family, enjoy![/size][/b]
[/b][/size][size=2][b]
[/b]I adore [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's beautiful portrait mod[/url] and while most of the NPCs I use in my game are covered by Nyapu and many other wonderful people, I noticed the Bear family was the only mod in my list still missing some matching portraits!

I've finally had time to finish the rest of the outfits so the mod now includes the full outfit selection (2 seasonal outfits, 1 outfit for each festival)!

The Content Patcher version of this mod read your config settings for the Bear Family thanks to Cross-Mod Compatility Tokens. Let me know if there's any issues, this is my first Content Patcher mod!

[b]INSTALLATION (CONTENT PATCHER):[/b][/size][list=1]
[*][size=2]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens[/url]﻿ and place in your mods folder[/size]
[*][size=2][size=2]Download The Bear Family [size=2]and place in your mods folder[/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=2]Download this mod[/size]
[*][size=2]Place the [CP] Bear Family Nyapu Portraits to your mods folder[/size]
[*][size=2]Enjoy![/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][size=2][b]INSTALLATION (MANUAL): 
[/b][/size][list=1]
[*][size=2]Download and Install The Bear Family mod - set the following in the config.json "SeasonalOutfits": "lite",[/size]
[*][size=2]Download this mod [/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip and extract the "Bear Family Custom NPCs" folder and allow it to overwrite[/size]
[*][size=2]Enjoy your portraits! [/size]
[/list][size=2]
[b]CREDITS
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]Nyapu[/url] and their incredible portraits!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/76674678]maddogofblank[/url], the creator for the Bear Family and its wonderful cast of characters[/size]
